auto duration_ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &duration_ms, 1, MPI_LONG, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
edits.rationale: The in-place maximum reduction makes the existing canonical output and duration-derived performance metrics use the maximum rank duration without changing computation or result collection.

notes: Source lines 284–288 already measure each rank's complete runSimulation call. The reduction follows the duration calculation at original line 299, outside the measured interval; no barriers are required. Supplied target-platform compile-only evidence establishes that duration_ms has C++ type long on the recorded GCC/libstdc++ 13.2.0 LP64 target, exactly matching MPI_LONG.
